title: 新加坡碧山—宏茂橋公園河川復育
titleEn: Bishan–Ang Mo Kio Park river restoration
summary: 碧山—宏茂橋公園讓河川與公園共享空間；學徒需同時追蹤洪水佔用、河岸侵蝕、生態棲地與晴天活動，不把草地一律視為永久乾燥。
summaryEn: Bishan–Ang Mo Kio Park shares space between river and park; learners track flood occupation, erosion, habitat and dry-weather use without assuming lawns stay permanently dry.
scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 上游集水與公園入口：集水面積與逕流量：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Upstream catchment and park entry: Catchment area and runoff volume: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 上游集水與公園入口：集水面積與逕流量 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Upstream catchment and park entry: Catchment area and runoff volume and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 降雨量乘面積提供總水量，以逕流係數近似扣除入滲與其他損失；該係數隨土壤與前期濕度而變。本單元在「上游集水與公園入口」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Rain depth times area gives total water; a runoff coefficient approximates infiltration and other losses and varies with soil and antecedent moisture. Examine this relationship at upstream catchment and park entry.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：雨深P=30 mm、集水面積A=10000 m²、C=0.75。公式 V=CPA/1000；代入 0.75*30*10000/1000 = 225 m³。適用邊界：事件總量近似，不能推得尖峰流率或管線容量。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: rainP=30 mm, catchmentA=10000 m² andC=0.75. Formula V=CPA/1000; substitution 0.75*30*10000/1000 = 225 m³. Boundary: Event-volume approximation; does not predict peak flow or pipe capacity.
steps.failure: 把mm直接乘m²而未除1000會造成千倍錯誤。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
steps.failureEn: Multiplying mm bym² without dividing by1000 gives a thousandfold error. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
steps.check: 畫屋頂、路面與綠地分區，分別加權C並核對雨量站。在離線場景為「上游集水與公園入口」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
steps.checkEn: Map roofs, pavement and vegetation, weight C separately and check rainfall data. Build an offline evidence table for upstream catchment and park entry; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

knowledge.title: 上游集水與公園入口：集水面積與逕流量
knowledge.titleEn: Upstream catchment and park entry: Catchment area and runoff volume

knowledge.textEn: Rain depth times area gives total water; a runoff coefficient approximates infiltration and other losses and varies with soil and antecedent moisture. Examine this relationship at upstream catchment and park entry.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 先點選「上游集水與公園入口」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把C降成0.50，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 150 m³。與基準 225 m³比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
knowledge.textEn: Select the upstream catchment and park entry measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only C to0.50 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 150 m³. Compare with baseline 225 m³ and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

steps.title: 公園可淹水區：調蓄與連續方程：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Floodable park zones: Storage and continuity: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 公園可淹水區：調蓄與連續方程 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Floodable park zones: Storage and continuity and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 調蓄量隨入流減出流累積；容積夠大仍須確認退水能力，否則下一場雨開始時未必為空。本單元在「公園可淹水區」觀察此因果關係。
steps.instructionEn: Storage accumulates inflow minus outflow; sufficient geometric volume is not enough if drawdown leaves it occupied before the next storm. Examine this relationship at floodable park zones.
steps.observation: 明示假設的教學子模型，非場址量測：一小時內 Qin=2.0 m³/s、Qout=0.6 m³/s。公式 ΔV=(Qin-Qout)Δt；代入 (2.0-0.6)*3600 = 5040 m³。適用邊界：矩形單一歷線且無滲漏；真實設計必須積分完整降雨歷線。
steps.observationEn: Explicitly hypothetical teaching submodel, not site measurements: over one hour Qin=2.0 m³/s and Qout=0.6 m³/s. Formula ΔV=(Qin-Qout)Δt; substitution (2.0-0.6)*3600 = 5040 m³. Boundary: One rectangular hydrograph without leakage; real design must integrate the full event hydrograph.
steps.failure: 水位計零點漂移會看似增加儲量，需獨立水尺確認。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
